name: 1-play.jpg
shows: THE ECLIPSE mid-fight on wave 10, in the ruined crystal observatory. The boss is large and bright in its last phase (TOTALITY, shifting colour, now Verdant), its name on a plate above the corona, and its Shadow Ring is tightening (the threat). The Warden casts Verdant into it while the Prism branches in Ember and Azure bounce off walls and mirrors into minions of the other colours. Boss, Warden and Core form a triangle with open floor between them. HUD: 'WIN: break THE ECLIPSE after wave 10 · LOSE: the Core shatters', CORE 9/12 with '0 = RUN LOST', the boss phase bar, INCOMING, the event log ('Shadow Ring!'), 'MATCH COLOUR' and the named build. Chosen by tools/find-cover.mjs from 1,200 autopilot runs; ?shot=play replays that exact step.

name: 2-title.jpg
shows: The title screen over the observatory floor: logo, tagline, 'OBJECTIVE  WIN: break THE ECLIPSE after wave 10 · LOSE: the Core shatters', '10 waves · 7 kinds of Shade · 9 upgrades · a three-phase boss', a live reflected beam show, controls, RULES OF LIGHT opening with 'Match the beam to the Shade's colour', BEST SCORE 28,410 and 'Click to begin'.

name: 3-upgrade.jpg
shows: The moment before the boss: WAVE 9 CLEARED with a large 'NEXT: THE ECLIPSE' preview drawn by the boss's own renderer and its three phases (UMBRA, PENUMBRA, TOTALITY) named one per line, above three upgrade cards with icon, level, effect and how each combines with the build, plus Core, score and YOUR BUILD.

name: 4-results.jpg
shows: VICTORY with THE ECLIPSE drawn small beneath it, dimmed and cracked, then the stats (waves, Shades dispelled, colour accuracy, best combo, time), score 32,925 marked NEW BEST over the previous 28,410, the build taken by name and level, and 'Press R or click to play again'. Below it: 'Lose the Core and the run ends: CORE SHATTERED · press R to try again' (the real defeat screen is ?shot=defeat).
